technical_sources.confirmed: GlossyEnvironmentReflection samples reflection probes and uses perceptual roughness for the sampled reflection.
technical_sources.not_confirmed: Full indirect diffuse illumination; reflection probes do not replace lightmaps or a complete lighting solution.
